'''Taivas''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Zhar system]], on which the [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] was built.

==History==
Its remote location in the [[Zhar system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] was picked by [[Rawk|Nat Skywalker]] for the [[Hidden Temple (Sith–Imperial War)|Hidden Temple]]. Nat's brother, [[Kol Skywalker]], changed the atmosphere of the planet using [[Yuuzhan Vong]] terraforming, yet without updating the official records on the planet.

In [[137 ABY]], the planet hosted the crew of [[Cade Skywalker]]'s ship, the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']], along with Nat Skywalker, former Jedi [[Azlyn Rae]], and an [[Empire-in-exile|Imperial]] delegation of three [[Imperial Knight]]s: [[Marasiah Fel]], [[Ganner Krieg]], and [[Antares Draco]].

==Fauna==
Bioluminescent octopoid creatures were known to float around the temple area.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Wikipedia:Finnish language|Finnish]], ''taivas'' means "sky" or "heaven".
